references.text: Moses intercedes with the Lord, as he also does here when he asks for a new leader for the people.
Another example of Moses speaking to the Lord on behalf of the people and interceding for them.
Moses turns to the Lord in prayer for the people of Israel, a pattern that is repeated throughout his service.
Moses prays to the Lord to be allowed to enter the Promised Land, and the Lord gives instructions about Joshua as his successor.
The fulfillment of Moses' prayer where Joshua is appointed as his successor to lead Israel.
